title: UI Test
description: Test mobile, tablet and desktop breakpoints, as well as RTL and dark mode.
responsiveHint: The layout must adapt from 320px to 1920px without breaking, and stay readable in dark mode.
tip: Tip: resize the window, enable dark mode via the button in the topbar, and use devtools in the developer tools to test RTL.

i18n.title: Internationalization demo
i18n.description: Preview of localized formats (dates, numbers, currency, plurals) and RTL direction based on the active locale.
i18n.switchLabel: Switch language via the topbar to see formats change without a reload.
